pages.text: Welcome to $(thing)Xulai Seed Seasons$()!$(br2)This mod builds on top of Serene Seasons to give crops a full $(crop)season-based farming cycle$().$(br2)Four core systems:$(li)$(l:seedseasons:crop_seasons/welcome)Crop seasons$(/l)$(li)$(l:seedseasons:crop_lifecycle/welcome)Day-based crop growth$(/l)$(li)$(l:seedseasons:water_management/welcome)Water consumption$(/l)$(li)$(l:seedseasons:seasonal_daynight/welcome)Seasonal day & night length$(/l)

pages.title: More Chapters & This Book
pages.text: The $(l:seedseasons:agriculture/irrigator)Irrigator$() and $(l:seedseasons:maid_compat/welcome)farm maids$() can run the field for you, and $(l:seedseasons:water_management/cauldrons)cauldrons collect rainwater$().$(br2)Getting Started also has a $(l:seedseasons:getting_started/quick_start)Quick Start$(), a $(l:seedseasons:getting_started/config_reference)Config Reference$(), $(l:seedseasons:getting_started/status)Reading Your Field$() and $(l:seedseasons:getting_started/troubleshooting)Troubleshooting$() - check those four first when something seems wrong.$(br2)Use $(bold)Index$() on the landing page to search and $(bold)History$() to go back; $(italic)shift-click$() items in the book to jump to their crafting page.
